decisions.reason: Although a construction site dumper fits the construction side of our business, its only brief website mention and the crowded, less-differentiated nature of this segment suggest we should reallocate resources to more specialized equipment lines.
The inclined furniture lift is more peripheral to our core heavy-duty industrial and underground applications, and its lack of continued web presence indicates insufficient strategic traction.

The inclined building material lift matches our strengths in safe, reliable lifting solutions for demanding construction work and remains close to the kind of application-focused machinery our customers expect from us.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift offers a more professional, service-oriented lifting solution with better fit to commercial operators and after-sales support capabilities than a standalone furniture lift.
